label: Words: Compute & close

params.name: lede
params.default: The return's figures from the mapped books and 26AS: total income, tax, credit and what is left - then sign-off, filing and closing the year.
params.label: lede

params.name: interest_hint
params.default: Worked out to {day} from the 26AS challans. Type a figure to override; clear it to go back to the calculation.
params.label: interest hint

params.name: head_BP
params.default: Profits and gains of business or profession
params.label: head BP

params.name: t_paid
params.default: Less: advance + self-assessment tax as per 26AS
params.label: t paid

params.name: no_books
params.default: No mapped rows yet - map the statements in Intake & map first.
params.label: no books

params.name: no_26as
params.default: No 26AS uploaded - the credit side is empty. Upload it in Reconcile.
params.label: no 26as

params.name: red_open
params.default: {n} red {n:finding|findings} in Reconcile still need clearing before sign-off.
params.label: red open

params.name: sign_stale
params.default: The figures changed after the sign-off - sign off again.
params.label: sign stale

params.name: sign_body
params.default: You stand behind total income {income}, tax {tax} and {balance}. Any later change to the figures shows the sign-off as stale.
params.label: sign body

params.name: signoff_stage
params.default: Move the year to Review in Clients & years before signing off.
params.label: signoff stage

params.name: signoff_red
params.default: {n} red {n:finding|findings} in Reconcile have no explanation yet.
params.label: signoff red

params.name: file_body
params.default: The year moves to Filed and closes: no new statements, refs, portal files or notes. To change it later, start a revised return (the filed one is kept).
params.label: file body

params.name: closed_note
params.default: Closed. This year is filed; everything is kept as it was.
params.label: closed note

params.name: need_signoff
params.default: Sign off the computation before marking the year filed.
params.label: need signoff

params.name: need_ack
params.default: Give the 15-digit acknowledgement number from the ITR-V.
params.label: need ack

params.name: no_reopen
params.default: Only someone with the reopen right can take a filed year back.
params.label: no reopen

params.name: bad_interest
params.default: Interest must be a number of rupees.
params.label: bad interest

params.name: dl_util_hint
params.default: Open the ITR-3 utility › TDS2 / IT sheets › Import CSV.
params.label: dl util hint

params.name: k_too_late
params.default: Too late - no return can be filed for this year now
params.label: k_too_late

params.name: will_be
params.default: Filed on that date this is: {kind} (worked out from the dates).
params.label: will_be

params.name: too_late
params.default: No return can be filed for this year on that date (past the ITR-U window, or an ITR-U was already filed).
params.label: too_late

params.name: already_filed
params.default: A return is already filed. Start a revised return to file again.
params.label: already_filed

params.name: revise_body
params.default: The year opens again for changes. The {kind} (ack {ack}, filed {on}) stays on record and stands until the new return is filed; the revised ITR asks for its ack and date. The sign-off is cleared.
params.label: revise_body

params.name: revise_ok
params.default: Revision started - the year is open.
params.label: revise_ok

params.name: revising_note
params.default: Revising. The return that stands: {kind}, ack {ack}, filed {on} - quote these in the revised ITR.
params.label: revising_note

params.name: discard_body
params.default: Changes stay as they are, but the year closes again on the {kind} (ack {ack}). Nothing new is filed.
params.label: discard_body

params.name: discard_ok
params.default: Revision discarded - closed on the return that stands.
params.label: discard_ok

params.name: withdraw_body
params.default: For a return marked filed by mistake or with a wrong ack. The record stays, marked withdrawn, with your reason; the year opens again.
params.label: withdraw_body

params.name: need_reason
params.default: Say why the filing is undone.
params.label: need_reason

params.name: nothing_filed
params.default: No filed return to work on.
params.label: nothing_filed

params.name: no_revision_window
params.default: The revision window has closed and an ITR-U is not possible now.
params.label: no_revision_window

params.name: future_date
params.default: The date filed cannot be after today.
params.label: future_date

params.name: itru_add
params.default: ITR-U: additional tax u/s 140B @ {pct}% = {amount} - pay it with the tax before filing.
params.label: itru_add

params.name: itru_base
params.default: Further tax and interest over the return that stands: {extra} (that return: {before}; positive = payable).
params.label: itru_base

params.name: itru_confirm
params.default: I confirm: no search, survey or requisition; no assessment, reassessment or recomputation pending or done for this year; no prosecution - so an ITR-U is allowed (s.139(8A)).
params.label: itru_confirm

params.name: itru_not_more
params.default: An updated return (ITR-U) must leave more tax to pay than the return that stands - it cannot lower the tax, create or raise a refund, or raise a loss.
params.label: itru_not_more

params.name: itru_confirm_needed
params.default: Tick the ITR-U confirmation (no search, survey, assessment or prosecution) before filing.
params.label: itru_confirm_needed

params.name: i_exempt
params.default: No 234B / 234C: resident senior citizen with no business income - no advance tax (s.207(2)).
params.label: i_exempt

params.name: ri_r_due
params.default: Interest on the refund u/s 244A, {from} to {to} (estimate; the department pays it with the refund, taxable as other income when received)
params.label: ri_r_due

params.name: ri_r_small
params.default: No interest on the refund u/s 244A: the refund is under 10% of the tax determined.
params.label: ri_r_small

params.name: dl_itr_hint
params.default: Balance sheet and P&L come from rows mapped ITR3 BS / PL <item>. Open it in the department's offline utility to complete the remaining schedules, then upload on incometax.gov.in.
params.label: dl_itr_hint

params.name: itr_no_schema
params.default: No CBDT schema for {form} here yet.
params.label: itr_no_schema

params.name: itr_where
params.default: Most come from the client master (address with PIN, email, mobile, date of birth / formation, father's name and PAN of the signatory) - fill them in Clients & years, or complete them in the department's utility.
params.label: itr_where

params.name: bs_differs
params.default: Balance sheet does not tally: off by {diff}
params.label: bs_differs

params.name: pl_ties
params.default: P&L profit before tax {pbt} = net profit taken to business income
params.label: pl_ties

params.name: pl_differs
params.default: P&L profit before tax {pbt} differs from the net profit in business income ({bp})
params.label: pl_differs

params.name: books_unknown
params.default: Not a balance sheet / P&L item: {items}
params.label: books_unknown

params.name: books_none
params.default: No balance sheet or P&L yet - map the final accounts' rows as ITR3 BS <item> / ITR3 PL <item> (e.g. ITR3 BS debtors, ITR3 PL salaries) and they fill Part A-BS and P&L.
params.label: books_none

params.name: dl_3cd_json
params.default: Form 3CB-3CD JSON (tax audit report, department format)
params.label: dl_3cd_json

params.name: dl_3cd_json_hint
params.default: Part A, you as the auditor, depreciation (cl. 18), loans accepted / repaid (cl. 31) and s.40A(2)(b) payments (cl. 23) from mapped rows. Open it in the department's 3CA-3CD / 3CB-3CD utility to complete the other clauses, then upload with your DSC.
params.label: dl_3cd_json_hint

params.name: tar_where
params.default: Part A comes from the client master; your own details (name, address, membership no., FRN) from My firm.
params.label: tar_where
